verdict.rationale: Muse's docs describe agent-driven automation — once a goal/task is set, Muse 'continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up' and monitors/follows up sending notifications — which shows event/schedule-triggered action, satisfying part of the automation-depth story. However, there is no evidence of an explicit user-facing rule-definition interface (e.g., 'if X happens, do Y' conditional triggers); the described behavior is goal-driven autonomy rather than user-authored rules, and no independent corroboration of this specific mechanism exists. Missing for 10: explicit rule/trigger authoring UI, documented conditional logic definitions, and independent verification of reliability under real events.
